blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano on Friday urged Filipinos to set aside political differences and present a united front as the country hosts the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. According to Cayetano, the country’s hosting of the regional gathering would put the Philippines under the spotlight of international media and leaders from different parts of the world. “Dito muna sa Asean, yes, you can be pro or anti the administration, but the Philippines is hosting,” Cayetano said in his Facebook livestream.
